item.title: Hiruzen Highland: Okayama's Jersey Cow Plateau — Guide
item.description: Hiruzen is a broad, gently rolling plateau in the far north of Okayama, spread beneath the three volcanic peaks known as the Hiruzen Sanza. Cooler and greener than the lowlands, it has become the prefecture’s summer escape and its dairy centre: Japan’s largest herd of Jersey cattle grazes here, and the rich milk goes into ice cream, yoghurt and cheese sold across the plateau. A long, mostly flat cycling path threads the highland past pastures, farm shops and flower fields, and in autumn the surrounding beech forests turn brilliant.
